arxiv-1502-00130.title: The Search for Computational Intelligence
arxiv-1502-00130.creator: Joseph Corneli, Ewen Maclean
arxiv-1502-00130.description:
A 2015 arXiv research paper by Joseph Corneli, Ewen Maclean. We define and explore in simulation several rules for the local evolution of generative rules for 1D and 2D cellular automata. Our implementation uses strategies from conceptual blending. We discuss potential applications to modelling social dynamics. 1
Introduction

This paper takes a local approach to studying the evolution of
cellular automata, following on the global approach of “PICARD”

[
23
]
. Like a traditional one-dimensional CA, PICARD executions move
from one iteration to another by some rule.

arxiv-1805-09885.title: The Kinetics of Primary Alpha Plate Growth in Titanium Alloys Journal: Met Trans A
arxiv-1805-09885.creator: Abigail K. Ackerman, Alexander J. Knowles, Hazel M. Gardner, André A. N. Németh, Ioannis Bantounas, Anna Radecka, Michael P. Moody, Paul A.J. Bagot, Roger C. Reed, David Rugg, David Dye
arxiv-1805-09885.description: Abstract The kinetics of primary α \alpha -Ti colony/Widmanstätten plate growth from the β \beta are examined in Ti-6246 , comparing a simple quasi-analytical model to experiment. The plate growth velocity depends sensitively both on the diffusivity D ⁡ ( T ) D(T) of the rate-limiting species and on the supersaturation around the growing plate.

arxiv-2106-14127.title: Visual Conceptual Blending with Large-scale Language and Vision Models
arxiv-2106-14127.creator: Songwei Ge, Devi Parikh
arxiv-2106-14127.description: Abstract We ask the question: to what extent can recent large-scale language and image generation models blend visual concepts? Given an arbitrary object, we identify a relevant object and generate a single-sentence description of the blend of the two using a language model. We then generate a visual depiction of the blend using a text-based image generation model.

arxiv-2302-14345.title: Sagbi combinatorics of maximal minors and a Sagbi algorithm Thanks: AC is supported by PRIN 2020355B8Y and by INdAM-GNSAGA
arxiv-2302-14345.creator: Winfried Bruns, Aldo Conca
arxiv-2302-14345.description: Abstract . The maximal minors of a matrix of indeterminates are a universal Gröbner basis by a theorem of Bernstein, Sturmfels and Zelevinsky. On the other hand it is known that they are not always a universal Sagbi basis. By an experimental approach we discuss their behavior under varying monomial orders and their extensions to Sagbi bases.

arxiv-2305-01832.title: Limits on High-Frequency Gravitational Waves in Planetary Magnetospheres
arxiv-2305-01832.creator: Tao Liu, Jing Ren, Chen Zhang
arxiv-2305-01832.description: Abstract High-frequency gravitational waves (HFGWs) carry a wealth of information on the early Universe with a tiny comoving horizon and astronomical objects of small scale but with dense energy. We demonstrate that the nearby planets, such as Earth and Jupiter, can be utilized as a laboratory for detecting the HFGWs.

arxiv-2310-02387.title: Exponential Lower Bounds for Fictitious Play in Potential Games
arxiv-2310-02387.creator: Ioannis Panageas, Nikolas Patris, Stratis Skoulakis, Volkan Cevher
arxiv-2310-02387.description: Abstract Fictitious Play (FP) is a simple and natural dynamic for repeated play with many applications in game theory and multi-agent reinforcement learning. It was introduced by Brown [ 3 , 4 ] and its convergence properties for two-player zero-sum games was established later by Robinson [ 15 ] .

arxiv-2407-12064.title: LiteGPT: Large Vision-Language Model for Joint Chest X-ray Localization and Classification Task
arxiv-2407-12064.creator: Khai Le-Duc, Ryan Zhang, Ngoc Son Nguyen, Tan-Hanh Pham, Anh Dao, Ba Hung Ngo, Anh Totti Nguyen, Truong-Son Hy text
arxiv-2407-12064.description: Abstract Vision-language models have been extensively explored across a wide range of tasks, achieving satisfactory performance; however, their application in medical imaging remains underexplored. In this work, we propose a unified framework - LiteGPT - for the medical imaging. We leverage multiple pre-trained visual encoders to enrich information and enhance the performance of vision-language models.

arxiv-2512-24044.title: Jailbreaking Attacks vs. Content Safety Filters: How Far Are We in the LLM Safety Arms Race?
arxiv-2512-24044.creator: Yuan Xin, Dingfan Chen, Linyi Yang, Michael Backes, Xiao Zhang
arxiv-2512-24044.description: Abstract As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed, ensuring their safe use is paramount. Jailbreaking, adversarial prompts that bypass model alignment to trigger harmful outputs, present significant risks, with existing studies reporting high success rates in evading common LLMs.

pmc-10606679.creator: Lourdes Alcaide-Ruggiero, Verónica Molina-Hernández, Juan Morgaz, J Andrés Fernández-Sarmiento, María M Granados, Rocío Navarrete-Calvo, José Pérez, Setefilla Quirós-Carmona, José M Carrillo, Ramón Cugat, Juan M Domínguez, Wasim S Khan, Antonella Fioravanti
pmc-10606679.description: This study performs an analysis that will enable the evaluation of the quality, durability, and structure of repaired cartilaginous extracellular matrix tissue using an autologous-based particulated autograft cartilage and platelet-rich plasma treatment (PACI + PRP). A single-blind controlled experiment was conducted on 28 sheep to evaluate the efficacy of the PACI + PRP treatment for cartilage defects.

pmc-10629391.creator: Feng Liao, Yilan Xia, Wenpeng Gu, Xiaoqing Fu, Bing Yuan
pmc-10629391.description: BackgroundShotgun metagenomic and 16S rDNA sequencing are commonly used methods to identify the taxonomic composition of microbial communities. Previously, we analysed the gut microbiota and intestinal pathogenic bacteria configuration of migratory seagulls by using 16S rDNA sequencing and culture methods.

pmc-12433473.title: Biodiversity threats and socio-ecological dynamics in Chebera Churchura National Park: A One Health approach
pmc-12433473.creator: Tadesse Guadu, Berhanu Abera, Kissanet Tesfay, Anteneh Berhane, Ararso Tafese, Tarekegn Solomon, Belete Debebe, Melaku Getachew, Agumas Shibabaw, Alfoalem Araba Abiye, Mukarim Abdurahman, Waktole Yadeta, Yordanos Tadesse, Teshale Aymeta, Theodore JD Knight-Jones, Siobhan M Mor, Seid Tiku Mereta, Mir
pmc-12433473.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Chebera Churchura National Park (CCNP), a protected area in Ethiopia renowned for its diverse and thriving ecosystems, including nearly one-third of the nation's African elephant population and the largest concentration of African buffalo, grapples with pressing conservation challenges. We conducted a study in 2024 in the Konta and Dwauro Zones to assess the park's conservation status and ecosystem services using a One Health (OH) approach.

pmc-12467371.title: Gasdermin-Mediated Pyroptosis in Hidradenitis Suppurativa: Molecular Insights and Therapeutic Implications
pmc-12467371.creator: Kinga Tyczyńska, Piotr K. Krajewski, Aleksandra Sójka, Danuta Nowicka-Suszko, Iwona Bednarz-Misa, Mariusz Fleszar, Małgorzata Krzystek-Korpacka, Jacek C. Szepietowski
pmc-12467371.description: Simple SummaryHidradenitis suppurativa is a chronic skin disease characterized by painful, recurrent skin abscesses and tunnels in areas such as the armpits and groin. It severely impacts patients’ lives, causing discomfort and psychological distress. Despite affecting many people, the exact cause of this condition is not fully understood, making it difficult to manage effectively.

pmc-13212981.title: Topological structure and influencing factors of the spatial CO₂ emission network in Chinese cities
pmc-13212981.creator: Fengmei Yang, Xuefang Zhang, Nian Wang, Shudi Zuo, Meng Yang
pmc-13212981.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Investigating the spatial correlation characteristics of CO2 emissions is crucial for promoting regional collaborative emission reduction. This study examines 334 Chinese cities, employing an adjusted gravity model to construct a carbon emission spatial correlation network (CESCN). Utilizing social network analysis (SNA) methods, it systematically examines the network structure characteristics, dynamic evolution patterns across 2005, 2010, 2015, and 2020, and the driving factors for 2020.

pmc-13349955.title: Integrating network pharmacology, molecular docking, and experimental verification to investigate the mechanism of baicalein in colorectal cancer
pmc-13349955.creator: Jiahe Wang, Kunyu Han, Bingkun Chen, Yupei Guo, Jinyan Zhao, Xiaoqin Zhu, Jiumao Lin, Yong Chen
pmc-13349955.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundBaicalein (BA) is a major bioactive flavonoid derived from Scutellaria baicalensis Georgi. Accumulating evidence has demonstrated that BA exhibits remarkable antitumor activity. However, the mechanisms underlying its effects in colorectal cancer (CRC) remain unclear. This study aimed to elucidate the potential therapeutic mechanisms of BA in CRC through an integrated approach using network pharmacology (NP), molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations (MDS), and experimental validation.MethodsFirst, potential targets of BA and CRC were retrieved from public databases, and overlapping targets were identified.

pmc-13352854.title: Chronic fatigue syndrome in nursing practice: a concept analysis
pmc-13352854.creator: Yazhuo Gao, Qianyin Zhu, Min Xu
pmc-13352854.description: BackgroundNurses are essential in chronic fatigue syndrome (CFS) management, serving as care coordinators and patient advocates, but currently lack a unified guiding framework. CFS affects about 0.89% of the global population based on CDC-1994 criteria, with higher prevalence in women.

pmc-13399860.title: Dual Labral and Ligamentum Teres Reconstruction Achieves High Functional Outcomes and Arthroplasty‐Free Survivorship at 2 Years
pmc-13399860.creator: Roger Quesada‐Jimenez, Krishi Rana, Matthew J Strok, Ady H Kahana‐Rojkind, Alexander K Burt, Etan P Sugarman, Benjamin G Domb
pmc-13399860.description: PurposeTo evaluate the clinical outcomes and survivorship of hip arthroscopy with simultaneous labral and ligamentum teres (LT) reconstruction for the treatment of irreparable labral and LT tears, with a minimum follow‐up of 2 years.MethodsProspectively collected data were retrospectively reviewed for patients who underwent combined arthroscopic labral and LT reconstruction between 2017 and 2021.

pmc-13673733.title: Predictors of physical and mental health in youth with disabilities: the role of Paralympic sport participation
pmc-13673733.creator: Luca Puce, Carlo Biz, Piergiorgio Andrisano, Pietro Ruggieri, Piotr Zmijewski, Nicola Luigi Bragazzi
